text.page_fit_note: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 57/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it
